輝達警告若需求預估過高、客戶取消或延後訂單，可能造成庫存減記、價格下降及毛利率受壓
claims.note: 'If we overestimate demand, or if customers cancel or defer orders... reduce average selling prices... write down our inventory... negatively impact our gross margins'

claims.claim: Visa 表示監管會增加合規成本與營運複雜度
claims.note: 'Complying with these and other regulations increases our costs and operational complexity'

claims.claim: Visa 表示監管會限制其執行網路規則的能力
claims.note: 'could limit our ability to enforce our payments system rules'

claims.claim: Visa 表示監管會減少收入機會
Visa 表示監管可能傷害公司的業務與財務結果
claims.note: 'complex and evolving global regulations that could harm our business and financial results'

claims.claim: Visa 表示交換費通常不是 Visa 收取的收入，但會影響交易量，交換費改變可能實質影響支付量與淨收入
claims.note: 'we generally do not receive any revenue related to IRFs... changes to these fees, whether voluntarily or by mandate, can substantially affect our overall payments volume and net revenue'

claims.claim: Visa 表示若監管使支付系統對發卡行或收單行吸引力下降，交易可能轉往競爭網路
claims.note: 'issuers and acquirers may find our payments system less attractive... increase the attractiveness of other payments systems, such as our competitors'

claims.claim: Visa 表示發卡行或收單行可能要求更高的回饋、折扣或優惠，這些費用減免直接影響淨收入
claims.note: 'some issuers and acquirers have obtained... incentives from us, including reductions in the fees that we charge, which directly impacts our net revenue'

claims.claim: Visa 表示定價壓力、折扣、rebates 與 incentives 若無法抵銷可能傷害淨收入與利潤
claims.note: 'fee discounts, rebates... incentives... that impact our net revenue and profitability'; cost containment offset language

claims.claim: Visa 揭露監管可能降低支付量、淨收入、競爭地位及產品使用程度
claims.note: 'could negatively impact or reduce the number of Visa products our clients issue, the volume of payments we process, our net revenue... our competitive positioning'

claims.claim: Mastercard FY2025 10-K（財年截至 2025-12-31）
Mastercard 表示監管會增加合規與治理負擔、提高成本
claims.note: 'significant compliance and governance burdens or otherwise increase our costs'

claims.claim: Mastercard 表示監管可能降低客戶參與意願、減少國內與跨境交易量、影響創新與差異化、影響獲利能力
claims.note: 'customers could be less willing to participate... reduce the volume of domestic and cross-border transactions... impact our profitability and/or limit our ability to innovate'

claims.claim: Mastercard 表示若監管其 network fees 可能對經營結果造成重大不利影響
claims.note: 'any regulation... related to the type and level of network fees... could also materially and adversely impact our results of operations'

claims.claim: Mastercard 表示交換費不是其收入，但交換費過高會使商戶拒絕接受或導離交易
claims.note: 'Although we do not earn revenues from interchange... If interchange rates are too high, merchants may stop accepting our products or route transactions away'

claims.claim: Mastercard 表示交換費過低可能讓發卡行減少推廣、削減回饋或要求 Mastercard 降低費用，最終降低交易量與獲利能力
claims.note: 'issuers may stop promoting... reduce loyalty rewards'; 'seek a fee reduction from us'; 'ultimately reducing the volume of transactions over our network and our profitability'

claims.claim: Mastercard 表示若無法維持設定交換費的能力，結果可能對業務與經營結果造成重大不利影響
claims.note: 'If we are ultimately unsuccessful in defending our ability to establish interchange rates... material adverse impact on our overall business and results of operations'
